headline.en: Private credit exposure set to rise in DC pensions
headline.zh: DC养老金中的私募信贷敞口预计将上升

summary.en: Standard Life predicted that private market allocations in UK defined contribution default funds could rise to as much as 30 per cent by 2035, with private credit playing an increasingly important role. Research from Standard Life and WPI Economics found private market allocations in DC defaults could increase from around current levels.
summary.zh: Standard Life预测，到2035年，英国固定缴款（DC）默认基金中的私募市场配置可能升至高达30%，其中私募信贷将发挥越来越重要的作用。Standard Life与WPI Economics的研究发现，DC默认基金中的私募市场配置可能从当前水平上升。

headline.en: Blue Owl Technology Q2FY26 Results: NAV Stable at $16.48, NII Up
headline.zh: Blue Owl Technology 2026财年第二季度业绩：NAV稳定于16.48美元，NII上升

summary.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance reported Q2FY26 results. NAV was stable at $16.48 and net investment income rose.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance公布2026财年第二季度业绩。NAV稳定于16.48美元，净投资收益（NII）上升。

headline.en: CIFC launches direct lending strategy on iCapital Marketplace
headline.zh: CIFC 在 iCapital 平台推出直接贷款策略

summary.en: CIFC Asset Management, the $47bn alternative credit specialist, has launched its direct lending strategy on iCapital Marketplace. The strategy focuses on lending to US lower middle market companies. The launch provides an opportunity to explore how managers are expanding private credit access for wealth investors.
summary.zh: 规模 470 亿美元的另类信贷专业机构 CIFC Asset Management 已在 iCapital Marketplace 上推出其直接贷款策略。该策略专注于向美国低中端市场企业提供贷款。此次上线为探索管理人如何扩大财富投资者对私人信贷的准入提供了机会。

headline.en: Aegon adds triple-B exposure as primary CLO spreads sustain relative value
headline.zh: Aegon 增加 triple-B 敞口，CLO 一级市场利差维持相对价值

summary.en: Aegon added triple-B exposure as primary CLO spreads sustained relative value, according to a headline from Structured Credit Investor dated 17 September 2026. No deal size, manager or further terms were reported.
summary.zh: 据 Structured Credit Investor 2026 年 9 月 17 日的标题，Aegon 增加了 triple-B 敞口，CLO 一级市场利差维持相对价值。报道未披露交易规模、管理人或其他条款。

headline.en: Apollo in Talks to Expand SoftBank Loan to $9 Billion
headline.zh: Apollo正谈判将软银贷款扩大至90亿美元

summary.en: Apollo is in talks to expand a loan to SoftBank to $9 billion to fuel additional OpenAI investment, according to finance.biggo.com.
summary.zh: 据finance.biggo.com报道，Apollo正谈判将向软银提供的贷款扩大至90亿美元，以支持对OpenAI的进一步投资。

headline.en: US CLO Issuance Slips to $43.8B in August

summary.en: US CLO issuance slipped to $43.8 billion in August, according to CRE Daily. The article provides no further detail beyond the headline figure.
summary.zh: 据CRE Daily报道，8月美国CLO发行量降至438亿美元。除标题数字外，文章未提供更多细节。

headline.en: Blue Owl co-CEO says denying retail access to private markets is 'crazy'
headline.zh: Blue Owl 联席CEO称拒绝散户进入私募市场是"疯狂之举"

summary.en: A Blue Owl co-CEO said it is a 'crazy thing' to deny retail investors access to private markets, according to Top1000funds.com. No further details or figures were provided in the article.
summary.zh: 据 Top1000funds.com 报道，Blue Owl 一位联席CEO表示，拒绝散户投资者进入私募市场是"疯狂之举"。文章未提供更多细节或数据。

headline.en: KKR Doubles Private Debt Deals to $80 Billion as AI Spending Explodes
headline.zh: 随着AI支出激增，KKR私人债务交易规模翻倍至800亿美元

summary.en: KKR doubled its private debt deals to $80 billion, according to Benzinga, as spending on AI expands.
summary.zh: 据Benzinga报道，随着人工智能支出扩大，KKR的私人债务交易规模翻倍至800亿美元。

headline.en: Fed Rate Hikes Won't Trigger Private Credit Default Wave: PGIM
headline.zh: PGIM：美联储加息不会引发私人信贷违约潮

summary.en: PGIM stated that Federal Reserve rate hikes will not trigger a wave of defaults in private credit.
summary.zh: PGIM表示，美联储加息不会引发私人信贷违约潮。

headline.en: Apollo Says Hyperscaler Credit Default Swap Widening Not Driven by Dealer Inventory
headline.zh: Apollo 称超大规模企业信用违约互换走阔并非由交易商库存驱动

summary.en: Apollo said the widening in hyperscaler credit default swaps was not driven by dealer inventory. The article provides no further details on the scale of the moves or the parties involved.
summary.zh: Apollo 表示，超大规模企业信用违约互换的走阔并非由交易商库存驱动。文章未提供有关波动幅度或涉及各方的更多细节。
